feature_flags.description: Templates strangler, sequences, AI assist gates
Assignment, snooze, SLA collaboration on inbox threads
Canonical communications foundation (outbox, inbound envelope, adapters)
Global kill switch — blocks new outbound provider submits when enabled
Route human email sends through email_send_outbox
Zoho-style 3-column record detail layout. Users may opt in via profile preferences regardless of org setting.
Simple tenant navigation (disabled: restore full tab strip and contextual sidebar).
